about: Pinned answers of undocumented UAT behaviour, keyed by case id. Empty until the first full run, then pinned from it; an entry is {"verdict": "accept" | "reject", "words": "<text the rejection must contain>"}. Never pin "accept" for a recorded fill case (ids ending in -fill, -partial or -partial-close: the partial-fill probe and its close, the CO/BO and holdings fill cases): whether they fill depends on the market of the moment; expect.load_pinned refuses such a pin.
